scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up, very slow handheld push-in. A young woman's finger presses the record button on a small silver voice recorder; the red light turns on and glows. Guitar softly blurred behind, rain shimmer on the window, warm amber lamp light, 16mm film grain. no dialogue, no music

Slightly uneven handheld pan from the acoustic guitar to the rainy window. Woman A gently strums the guitar on the bed, Woman B beside her holds the recorder and smiles. Rain runs down the glass, warm lamp light, 16mm film grain. Keep both faces and outfits exactly as in the start frame. no dialogue, no music

Slow rack focus from raindrops on the window glass to the wet courtyard below with chalk drawings. Rain streaks run down the glass, droplets tremble. No people. 16mm film grain, soft halation. no dialogue, no music

Static macro shot. Raindrops hit cracked wet asphalt; pastel chalk pigment slowly dissolves and flows downhill in thin colored streams. No people. 16mm film grain, cool overcast light. no dialogue, no music

Slow handheld drift forward from behind at a three-quarter angle. Woman A and Woman B stand barefoot in the middle of the courtyard in light rain and glance at each other. Soft overcast light, 16mm film grain. Keep both outfits exactly as in the start frame. no dialogue, no music
